  1. Session knowledge: filter by phase (recon/scanning/exploit/privesc/credential/lateral/persistence/exfil/c2/reporting/other) and target IP to see what commands succeeded or failed in the past.
  2. Keyword search: find relevant entries across ALL parquets (GTFOBins, LOLBAS, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, session history).
